product.name: Fury
product.description:
* Four Size 2 cannons, optimized for absolute precision and control, and 4 Size 2 missiles make the Fury a revelation in short-range combat.

* A truly revolutionary approach to snub craft design maximizes portability and allows for quick launches into overwhelming swarm formations.

* Class-defying maneuverability and sense-shattering velocity thanks to deep integration of Xi’an tech and design.

isRelatedTo.name: Fury - Tengu Paint
isRelatedTo.description:
Announce the presence of the Fury with the Tengu livery, featuring a bold red base with black highlights.

*This paint is compatible with all Fury variants.*

isRelatedTo.name: Fury - Wasteland Paint
isRelatedTo.description:
Outfit your Fury in tan camo for a classic combat-ready look.

*This paint is compatible with all Fury variants.*

isRelatedTo.name: Fury - Templar Paint
isRelatedTo.description:
Stark white, complimented by red and black highlights, give your Fury a look that would be at home among the clouds.

*This paint is compatible with all Fury variants.*

isRelatedTo.name: Fury - Cloudburst Paint
isRelatedTo.description:
Go with the flow in your Fury with the Cloudburst livery, which blends blue and light grey for a distinct finish evoking the harmony between water and sky.

*This paint is compatible with all Fury variants.*

isRelatedTo.name: Fury - Sunrise Paint
isRelatedTo.description:
Primarily white with red accents streaking across the ship, this design lends the Fury an exciting aerodynamic look.

*This paint is compatible with all Fury variants.*

isRelatedTo.name: Fury - Mirai Racing Paint
isRelatedTo.description: Pull away from the pack with this daring Racing livery for the Mirai Fury. Combining coral reds with an undercurrent of teal, you're guaranteed to grab the attention of those you overtake when racing in these bold colors.

isRelatedTo.name: Racing Paint Collection
isRelatedTo.description: From underground meets to Murray Cup qualifying, this collection of 8 performance-focused ship paints has you covered at any circuit across the ‘verse. Includes Mirai Racing paints for the Fury and Razor; Murray Cup paints for the M50, Mustang, and P-72 Archimedes; and Star Kitten paints for the Sabre, Nox, and Pulse.

isRelatedTo.name: RSI Discovery Month Digital Goodies Pack
isRelatedTo.description:
Roberts Space Industries is a true aerospace legend, pioneering the technology that launched Humanity from the confines of Earth into the limitless depths of space. To honor this industry icon, this Digital Goodies Pack contains 15 RSI-themed in-game items.

The Galaxy Starwalker Paint and RSI Discovery Event Poster will be delivered in-game in a future patch.

offers.name: RSI Discovery Month Digital Goodies Pack

product.name: Genesis
product.description:
* Long-range transport that allows adventurous travelers to see the stars

* A huge seating capacity, proprietary fuel-efficient engines, private cabins, and solid defenses ensure safe and comfortable travel

* A versatile money-maker: start a travel empire, transport troops and tourists alike, and move vast amounts of freight on the side

product.name: Gladiator
product.description:
* The UEEN’s go-to dual-purpose fighter, featuring both air and air-to-ground combat functionality

* The pilot controls two Size 3 ballistic Gatlings, while a crew member operates the manned turret featuring dual Size 3 repeaters

* Also supports two Size 5 missile racks and four Size 2 missile racks

product.name: Gladius
product.description:
* This small, fast, single-crew light fighter is built for dogfighting

* Be victorious in combat thanks to two Size 3 repeaters, one Size 3 Gatling, and multiple missiles

* A combat maneuver speed of 225m/s greatly assists when evading enemy fire

product.name: S-65 Stingray
product.description:
Timeless Kruger design marries stylish form with exceptional function to transform your combat experience

Two S4 and four S2 concealed, interchangeable weapons equip this medium fighter to leave a lasting sting

Medium Fighters are designed to strike the balance between agility, firepower, and survivability to provide a well-rounded combat experience

isRelatedTo.name: Stingray - Domain Camo Paint
isRelatedTo.description: The Domain Camo paint adds various shades of grey in a digital-camo pattern to your Kruger S-65 Stingray.

isRelatedTo.name: Stingray - Manta Paint
isRelatedTo.description: The Manta paint features fiery orange accents that cut through your Kruger S-65 Stingray’s otherwise solid black hull.

isRelatedTo.name: Stingray - Protocol Paint
isRelatedTo.description: Crisp whites contrast against a deep black in the Protocol paint, completed with an eye-catching red that follows the smooth edges of your Kruger S-65 Stingray.

isRelatedTo.name: Kruger Laser Weapons Kit
isRelatedTo.description:
Add reliable laser cannons to your L-21 Wolf. Taken from the L-22 Alpha Wolf and S-65 Stingray, premium parts and cutting-edge manufacturing have created a laser repeater that thrives in the heat of battle. They can even be mixed for combined laser and ballistic firepower.

Includes two S4 Kruger Axiom L-22 laser repeaters.

isRelatedTo.name: Kruger Snub Laser Weapons Kit
isRelatedTo.description: Add a central laser gun to your P-52 Merlin, taken from the S-65 Stingray. Contains one S2 Whiptail STR-E2 laser repeater.

isRelatedTo.name: Kruger Snub Ballistic Weapons Kit
isRelatedTo.description: Add rapid-fire ballistic Gatling guns to your S-65 Stingray, taken from the P-52 Merlin. Contains two S2 Tigerstrike T-19P Gatling guns.

isRelatedTo.name: Kruger Ballistic Weapons Kit
isRelatedTo.description:
Add armor-shredding ballistic Gatlings to your Alpha Wolf or S-65 Stingray. Taken from the L-21 Wolf, Kruger's expert engineering allows this rotary cannon to fire rounds at head-spinning speeds with little worry of misfire. They can even be mixed for combined laser and ballistic firepower.

Includes two S4 Kruger Relentless L-21 Gatling guns.

product.name: Sabre
product.description:
* Rapidly respond to any combat scenario with this single-crew stealth fighter

* Four medium-sized laser repeaters deliver a powerful punch without the need to reload

* Numerous missiles also allow this expertly designed ship to attack from the shadows

isRelatedTo.name: Sabre - Star Kitten Paint
isRelatedTo.description: Embody Sally the Star Kitten's racing spirit with this custom Aegis Sabre livery. Combining the bright pink, vibrant blue, and crisp white of the beloved cartoon mascot, this livery brings a playfulness your competitors are sure to enjoy.

isRelatedTo.name: Sabre - Firebreak Paint
isRelatedTo.description: Ignite envy in others with the Sabre Firebreak livery, featuring vibrant red highlights against the black base paint.

isRelatedTo.name: Sabre - Harvest Paint
isRelatedTo.description: The Harvest livery for the Sabre features orange highlights that stand in bold contrast to the black base paint.

isRelatedTo.name: Sabre - Darkshade Paint
isRelatedTo.description: Envelop your Aegis Sabre in deep black for a sleek, professional look with the Darkshade livery.

isRelatedTo.name: Sabre - Tribunal Paint
isRelatedTo.description: Head out to the frontlines with your Aegis Sabre looking ready for action with the Tribunal paint in military green and yellow trim.

isRelatedTo.name: Sabre - Beyond Paint
isRelatedTo.description: Featuring dark teals with yellow trim, the Beyond paint for your Aegis Sabre is sure to inspire on your next mission.

isRelatedTo.name: Sabre - Windbreak Paint
isRelatedTo.description:
The Windbreak paint scheme exudes style by giving the Sabre a green body, dark grey wings, and silver and orange highlights.

*This paint is compatible with all Sabre variants.*

isRelatedTo.name: Sabre - Landslide Paint
isRelatedTo.description: The Landslide paint scheme for the Sabre features a tan fuselage with grey wings and subtle silver highlights.

isRelatedTo.name: Sabre - Polar Paint
isRelatedTo.description: Modify your Sabre with this white and grey camo paint scheme specifically designed for the 2950 IAE event on microTech.

isRelatedTo.name: Sabre - Stormbringer Paint
isRelatedTo.description: This custom Sabre paint scheme was created to celebrate the 2950 IAE on microTech. It blends dark grey and electric blue with white accents to give the ship a cool new look.

isRelatedTo.name: Racing Paint Collection
isRelatedTo.description: From underground meets to Murray Cup qualifying, this collection of 8 performance-focused ship paints has you covered at any circuit across the ‘verse. Includes Mirai Racing paints for the Fury and Razor; Murray Cup paints for the M50, Mustang, and P-72 Archimedes; and Star Kitten paints for the Sabre, Nox, and Pulse.

hasVariant.name: Sabre Comet
hasVariant.description:
* This dogfighting-focused variant of the Saber offers cannons and close-range scatterguns to decimate enemies

* Also comes equipped with missiles to attack enemies at longer range

* A specially created ‘Masters of Flight' paint scheme ensures you’ll be noticed on missions

hasVariant.name: Sabre Raven
hasVariant.description:
* Fly under the radar with an even stealthier evolution of the infamous Sabre

* Features a smaller wingspan and overall signature, plus improved avionics and added data storage

* Innovative weapon options include dual laser cannons and a pair of EMP pods for whisper-quiet electronic intervention

hasVariant.name: Sabre Firebird
hasVariant.description:
* 12x S3 missiles (up to 6 at once) provide overwhelming firepower

* Superior propulsion for fast engagement and evasion, whether rushing to a mission or getting out intact

* Protect what’s yours by targeting specific threats - essential for base defense and fleet security

hasVariant.name: Sabre Peregrine
hasVariant.description:
* Blazing Top Speed

* Hard to Kill

* Proven Military Chassis

hasVariant.name: Sabre Raven EX
hasVariant.description:
* Boasting four configurable weapon hardpoints, the Raven EX is armed to uphold the Sabre’s legacy and to finish the fight

* Disable the quantum drive of any enemy within reach with an inbuilt quantum dampener, so you control the terms of engagement

* Medium Fighters are designed to strike a balance between agility, firepower, and survivability to provide a well-rounded combat experience
